name: Vehicle purchase — type not specified
goal: When the user says they want to buy a vehicle without specifying car vs motorcycle (or old vs new), the bot must ask which — not assume one.
constraints: General edge case: under-specified / ambiguous user intent. The bot should clarify the vehicle type, never guess.

phases.verbatimUserMessage: I want to buy a vehicle
phases.completionCriteria: Bot recognizes the request is unclear and asks which vehicle purchase the user means (car vs motorcycle, and/or old vs new); it does NOT assume a specific option.
